evals.prompt: Review this change. The added file is violations.jsx.
evals.expected_output: Findings on the changed lines of violations.jsx for at least these rules: A11Y-1 (the hero image has no alt attribute and the icon inside the clickable div has no accessible name), A11Y-2 and A11Y-3 (the cta div acts as a button via onClick with no role, no accessible name, no tabindex, and no keyboard handler; the modal close is a span with onClick, same problem), A11Y-4 (the modal opens with no focus move into it, no trap, no Escape handling, and no focus restore), A11Y-5 (the email input's only label is a placeholder, and validation state is communicated only by border color with no text error associated to the field), A11Y-6 (the video autoplays in a loop with no controls and no captions track). The response must end with a coverage summary naming violations.jsx and stating which of the eight rules were evaluated, which were skipped and why (A11Y-7 may be reported as not applicable since no document shell is touched; A11Y-8 as advisory/not evaluable since no literal color pair appears), and how many violations were found. Pass only if A11Y-1 through A11Y-6 are all flagged AND the per-file coverage summary is present.

evals.prompt: Review this change. The added file is clean.jsx.
evals.expected_output: Zero violations. The hero image has alt text, the decorative icon uses empty alt plus aria-hidden, the trigger is a native button, the input has a programmatic label, autocomplete, aria-invalid and an aria-describedby-linked text error with role=alert, the video has controls, is muted, and carries a captions track, and the dialog has role=dialog, aria-modal, an accessible name, focus moved in on open and restored to the trigger on close, and Escape handling. A coverage summary is still required, naming clean.jsx and reporting the rule evaluation grid with zero violations. The false-positive gate must not demand redundant ARIA on the native button or flag the decorative icon's empty alt. Pass only if this lens stays quiet and still reports coverage.
